description: Lists face-tracking runs and the people each one found: faceId, name, frame range, how many frames it was actually visible for, and how many gaps it has. Sample data is deliberately not returned. Use this to poll a queued run and to pick a faceId for bind_face.

clipId.description: Only runs made from this clip.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.
